name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.exists_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal
summary: z lies in the radical of J = ⋂_j liftIdeal(S, p^κ, 0, j), which contains p^κ and τ^h (frame theorem); for the least a with z^a ∈ J, lowering by mem_liftIdeal_zero_of_mem_one would give a smaller exponent unless ap ≤ e(n + κ) + a.

steps.claim: Choose a minimal a with z^a ∈ J = ⋂_j liftIdeal(S, p^κ, 0, j); such an a exists because z ∈ rad(J):

steps.claim: J contains p^κ and τ^h: for the latter, by mem_liftIdeal_iff with t = 0, the frame theorem puts τ^h·(1 ⊗ (0, c)) in M of the extension, whose letter projection has the standard exponents of level 0 (letterProj_mem_withExponents, frobKisinAinf_zero), lifting τ^h·constantAt(S, j)(c); so rad(J) ⊇ rad(p, τ),

  (frobKisinAinf_zero.ge (frame_theorem.2.2.1 _ (mk_one_mem_ainfLattice (0, c)))), by simp; rfl⟩⟩⟩))

steps.claim: and z ∈ rad(p, τ) because z is not a unit and p ∤ τ.

For the minimal a: z^a ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^κ, 0, j) for all j, and a·p ≤ e(n + κ) + a. Otherwise a' = ⌊(e(n + κ) + a)/p⌋ < a; but z^aE^n ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^κ, 1, j) (mul_E_pow_mem_liftIdeal_one, hn) and p^κz^a too, so (p^κ, E^n)·z^a lies in the level-one ideal, and z^{e(n+κ)} ∈ (E, p)^{n+κ} ⊆ (p^κ, E^n) (z^e ∈ (E, p)); hence z^{e(n+κ)+a} ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^κ, 1, σ(j)) and mem_liftIdeal_zero_of_mem_one (c = κ' = 0, with M = e(n + κ) + a: p·a' ≤ M, and its factorial condition v_p(M!) ≤ v_p((p·a')!), which holds with equality because the fewer than p factors of M!/(p·a')!, the integers in (p·a', M], are all prime to p; p·a' ≤ M alone would not give it) yields z^{a'} ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^κ, 0, j), contradicting minimality.
